description: This file contains unit tests for parsing functions related to node lists and pairing lists in a shared module. It verifies the behavior of functions 'parseNodeList' and 'parsePairingList' with various inputs, ensuring correctness and robustness.

methods.name: parseNodeList
methods.description: Parses the 'node.list' payload, normalizing input to an array of nodes or empty array if invalid.

methods.name: parsePairingList
methods.description: Parses the 'node.pair.list' payload, normalizing the 'pending' and 'paired' lists, handling malformed or missing fields.
